parent_objective: run source-balanced boundary accounting over existing M1083 artifacts without new mining
blocked_by: M1086 implemented tooling but has not yet measured existing M1083 artifacts through the new source-budget path
invalidates: claiming the new tooling fixes M1083 without running it on existing artifacts
rerunning full matched-current or boundary relocation mining before a cheap artifact smoke

public_gates: M1087 must not use private holdout
M1087 must not run a full new mining pipeline
M1087 must use existing M1083 CSV artifacts only
M1087 must preserve existing robustness thresholds

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: applies M1086 source-budget and balanced export tooling to existing M1083 artifacts before any new surface run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure smoke only; no driver training, no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if source budget shows existing M1083 artifacts are intrinsically below ten eligible physical pairs
stop if balanced export cannot be evaluated from existing artifacts
stop if smoke would require rerunning mining
fallback_plan: if source budget is adequate but balanced export fails, route to source-balanced relocation run design
if source budget is inadequate, route to sampler expansion design
if tooling fails, route to implementation repair

hypothesis: The new source-balanced boundary tooling can cheaply classify whether the existing M1083 artifacts contain enough pre-boundary source diversity and whether post-export balance remains impossible without a new relocation run.
success_criteria: source-balanced artifact smoke runs on existing M1083 CSVs
summary distinguishes budget-limited from export-limited failure
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or full new mining run occurs
failure_criteria: artifact smoke cannot read existing M1083 CSVs
tooling requires full mining to run
training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout starts
decision_rule: M1087 may only run source-balanced accounting over existing M1083 artifacts. It cannot train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, run new mining, or weaken thresholds.
